==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Travel to the [[Gate of Fear]] and speak with the [[Apostate]].
* See Keeper Kauniss for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]]
* [[Inscribed Secret]]

==Walkthrough==
The quest is a simple matter of [[map travel]].

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Keeper Kauniss'''
:''"I know who can help us, <[[character]] name>. His name is the '''Apostate'''. He dwells in the '''Gate of Fear'''. He was a follower of [[Abaddon]]. I am sure he will have knowledge pertaining to the Hunter."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = We'll seek this person and learn what we can.
|decline = We'll not consort with Abaddon worshipers! Send someone else instead.
|ask = I urge you to speak with the '''Apostate'''. Surely he will know about the '''Hunter'''. }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
'''Apostate'''
:''"What is it? [[The Hunter]] and the Pack.... Yes I know of them. You've gained the attention of some very powerful beings there. If you are careful, or stronger than you look, you can kill members of the Pack. The Hunter...well the Hunter is a much more powerful being. You see, he's never truly dead. If you beat him down, he will wait until danger has passed and then regenerate and begin the hunt anew. He cannot be killed. Now, if that is all you require of me, I ask to be free of your presence."''

===Reward dialogue===
'''Keeper Kauniss'''
:''"What have you learned? The Hunter is invincible? I was worried about sssuch a thing. But at leassst we know that he can be evaded."''

==Trivia==
*[[w:Know Your Enemy|Know your enemy]] is a saying derived from Sun Tzu's The Art of War.
